ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low. The surface is predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels with a ratio of approximately 95:5 dark to high-intensity white features.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark-grey macro-field across both lobes; high-contrast white contiguous clusters located at the extreme distal tips; sparse, isolated white circular spots distributed across the interior lobe surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; calculated angle approximately 38 degrees with significant vertical penetration relative to the lobe horizontal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration characterized by high-frequency, low-amplitude pixel oscillations; a distinct deep semi-circular indentation is present on the proximal trailing edge of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex upward curve along the leading edges, tapering to sharp, narrow points at the distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast clusters of circular white rosettes (barnacle colonization) localized on the lateral tips; scattered individual rosettes on the mid-lobe surfaces.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, unaligned linear white pixel streaks (rake marks) predominantly visible on the lower-left lobe segment.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular notch/tissue deficit on the trailing edge of the right lobe adjacent to the median notch; extensive barnacle encrustation on both distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Base of the fluke is partially occluded by high-intensity pixel noise caused by water turbulence and spray.
